text.15 个标志版本 · 10 个辅助与延伸图形 · 3 个规范示意 · 40 个应: 15 logo versions · 10 auxiliary and extension graphics · 3 specification diagrams · 40 application templates · 6 extended palettes · 3 NASA images
text.spacelibre 字标使用现有矢量轮廓。网页正文与说明使用文字排版，方便阅读: The spacelibre wordmark uses the existing vector outlines. Body copy and captions on the site use live type, so they are easy to read, select and update.
text.主标题 48–80 px · 分区标题 28–40 px · 正文 16–20: Display heading 48–80 px · Section heading 28–40 px · Body 16–20 px
text.主色建立识别，辅色与强调色通过连续曲线和渐隐色带自然衔接，装饰位于内容之后，不用: The primary color builds recognition, while the secondary and accent colors flow together through continuous curves and fading ribbons. Decoration sits behind the content and never masks or cuts it with solid blocks. Every application updates with the site-wide palette, and previews and downloads are all SVG; placeholder content can be replaced.
text.主色承担识别，辅色塑造动势，强调色用于关键节点。: The primary color carries recognition, the secondary shapes momentum, and the accent marks key moments.
text.以 SVG 画布高度的 25% 为 x，在画布外侧四周各留出至少 x。文字、边框: With x equal to 25% of the SVG canvas height, leave at least x clear around all four outer edges of the canvas. Text, borders and other graphics stay out of the safe zone.
text.以上尺寸为建议值。24–32 px 时尖端与细缝会弱化，应按最终显示尺寸检查。: The sizes above are recommendations. At 24–32 px the tips and fine gaps weaken, so check at the final display size.
text.使用 NASA 官方发布的 Webb 影像作为辅助背景。文字采用网页排版，主标志: Use Webb imagery officially released by NASA as a supporting background. Text uses web typography, the primary logo is a palette-following SVG, and photographs keep their true colors.
text.保留安全留白，按最终尺寸检查细节。: Keep the safe spacing clear and check the details at the final size.
text.六套方案控制整个网页：背景、文字、卡片、按钮、SVG 标志与辅助图形、影像遮罩同: Six presets control the whole site: background, text, cards, buttons, SVG logos and supporting graphics, and image overlays all change together. The logo outlines keep their approved geometry.
text.六套配色，一套完整的视觉秩序。: Six palettes, one complete visual order.
text.只选主色，自动生成完整的全站色系。: Pick only a primary color and a complete site-wide palette is generated automatically.
text.同一套秩序，不同的画布。: The same order, on different canvases.
text.名片成品 90 × 54 mm，四周 3 mm 出血；A4、A3 文件为成品尺寸: Finished business card 90 × 54 mm with 3 mm bleed on all sides; A4 and A3 files are at finished size, so add bleed per your supplier's requirements.
text.大尺度裁切、色彩对撞、环形门、航迹网络、日蚀负形与多层光谱，构成更有冲击力的传播: Large-scale crops, color collisions, orbital gates, trajectory maps, eclipse negative space and layered spectra form a more striking communications language. The full logo still keeps its safe zone.
text.左右编排用于导航与产品界面；上下编排用于封面和居中展示；独立图标用于头像与紧凑空: The horizontal layout is for navigation and product interfaces; the stacked layout is for covers and centered displays; the standalone icon is for avatars and tight spaces.
text.彩色版本的圆环是一个完整正圆，使用辅色；前景轨道使用主色。两者随全站配色变化。单: In the color version the ring is a complete circle in the secondary color, and the foreground orbit uses the primary color; both follow the site-wide palette. In the monochrome version the ring, orbit and full wordmark all use a single color — black, white or navy — and do not split into primary and secondary. The joins keep even spacing, and the outline, ring thickness and tips scale together.
text.技术标签 12–16 px；间距采用 8 px 基础节奏。中文说明使用系统无衬线: Technical labels 12–16 px; spacing follows an 8 px base rhythm. Chinese captions use the system sans-serif font.
text.拉伸、旋转或单独移动字标与图标。: Stretch, rotate or move the wordmark and icon separately.
text.拖动滑块，以实际像素宽度查看独立图标。: Drag the slider to view the standalone icon at its actual pixel width.
text.按原比例缩放整个标志组合。: Scale the whole logo lockup proportionally.
text.推荐面积关系：深色 / 浅色基底 60%，主色 25%，辅色 10%，强调色 5: Recommended area ratio: deep / light base 60%, primary 25%, secondary 10%, accent 5%. Click a swatch to copy its value.
text.改变环厚、轨道尖端或交界处留白。: Change the ring thickness, orbit tips or the spacing at the joins.
text.替换字标字体，任意改变单个字母颜色。: Substitute the wordmark font or recolor individual letters freely.
text.正文 / 浅底 {a}:1 · 按钮文字 / 主色 {b}:1: Body / light base {a}:1 · Button text / primary {b}:1
text.没有找到对应模板，请调整关键词或分类。: No matching templates found. Try different keywords or categories.
text.添加发光、立体浮雕、描边或投影。: Add glow, embossing, outlines or drop shadows.
text.清楚的信息层级，克制的技术语言。: A clear information hierarchy and restrained technical language.
text.点击色卡复制 HEX 色值。印刷色需按纸张、油墨和 ICC 配置转换并打样。: Click a swatch to copy its HEX value. Print colors need converting for paper, ink and ICC profiles, then proofing.
text.由网格、留白与轨道形态建立科技感。: Build a technical feel through grids, spacing and orbital forms.
text.网页可离线打开。SVG 自包含；标志字标保持矢量轮廓，新增应用的说明文字保留可编: The site opens offline. SVGs are self-contained; logo wordmarks keep their vector outlines, and captions for newly added applications stay as editable text. When replacing outline copy in older templates, create a text layer in your design software.
text.网页负责阅读，SVG 负责设计交付。: The web page is for reading; SVG is for design handoff.
text.背景、文字、SVG 与影像遮罩同步变化: Background, text, SVG and image overlays change together
text.视觉识别手册 · 从精确的轨道结构，到大胆的色彩与宇宙影像。: Visual identity manual · from precise orbital structures to bold color and cosmic imagery.
text.让真实宇宙，成为品牌的舞台。: Let the real universe become the brand's stage.
text.请输入有效的六位 HEX 色值，例如 #007BFF。: Enter a valid six-digit HEX value, for example #007BFF.
text.调整遮罩，让标志和标题在复杂影像上仍然清晰。: Adjust the overlay so the logo and title stay legible over busy imagery.
text.轨道，不止是一条线。: An orbit is more than a line.
text.选择上方全站方案，或用拾色盘自定义主色。色彩会贯穿整个手册，以下展示当前方案的主: Choose a site-wide preset above, or use the color picker to set a custom primary color. Color runs through the whole manual; below are the current preset's primary, deep base and light base.
text.选择与背景对比清晰的配色版本。: Choose a color version with clear contrast against the background.
